text.name: Banco Delta Asia
text.rules: Record "accounts frozen". Draw from LIO's Contingency deck. If the result is 3 or more, LIO spends 2 points; otherwise, LIO spends 1 point, then SAE spends 1 point.
text.history: On 15 September 2005 the US Treasury designated Banco Delta Asia in Macau a "primary money laundering concern" over North Korean accounts; Macau froze about 50 accounts holding some $25 million.
